# Hostile argument vectors for scripts/runner/deps.sh. test-runners.sh runs each one under each bash on the
# machine, from the working directory of fixtures/target/cases.txt, which also holds Cargo.lock,
# sub/Cargo.lock, .cargo/Cargo.lock, big/Cargo.lock of 50 MB and one byte, .npmrc, .yarnrc.yml,
# package.json, package-lock.json, sub/package-lock.json and npm-shrinkwrap.json. AUDITOR_RUN_TIMEOUT is
# not set.
# One case per line: <exit status><TAB><the one stderr line><TAB><argument>[<TAB><argument>...]. Each
# case prints nothing on stdout, makes no scratch directory and changes nothing in the working directory.
